modernity.evidence: Dark theme with a rounded hero card, pill badge and bold sans-serif headline; current design.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: Headline with yellow accent words draws the eye, then primary and secondary buttons side by side.

mobile_usability.evidence: On mobile the hero stacks, buttons go full width and the trust line becomes a vertical list.

readability.evidence: Light text on navy is legible; the trust line under the hero is smaller and lower contrast.

imagery_quality.evidence: Sunset sea illustration with a sailboat silhouette; clean and on-theme, though not a photo.

trust_signals.evidence: Gold stars with 4.9 from 410 reviews, "Licensed skipper · Since 2011", departure times and phone.

cta_clarity.evidence: Yellow "Book now" in the header and a large "Book a trip — from €95" button in the hero.

brand_consistency.evidence: Navy and amber used consistently for the logo dot, accents, buttons and stars.

summary.en: Polished dark-themed charter page with an obvious booking path, price anchor and strong social proof. Works well on mobile.
summary.fr: Page de location de bateau soignée, au thème sombre, avec un parcours de réservation évident, un prix d'appel et des avis bien mis en avant. Fonctionne bien sur mobile.
